title: Ambiguous between
statement: How many multiples of $4$ are there between $12$ and $48$?
solution: The multiples are $12, 16, \dots, 48$, that is $4\cdot 3$ to $4 \cdot 12$, and the multiplier runs from $3$ to $12$, so there are $10$. Why this works. divisibility-rules: writing each multiple as four times a number makes the count direct.
check_program: print(sum(1 for n in range(12, 49) if n % 4 == 0))
